decisions.reason: Its close alignment with the firm's existing vessel management knowledge allows effective assimilation and improvement, so it is likely retained.
Crew and travel services build directly on existing competencies, enabling the firm to learn from early results and adjust, so dropping is unlikely.
The portal leverages existing operational data but requires digital capabilities where the firm's absorptive capacity is thinner, leading to a moderate drop risk.
The mobile app is a more distant digital extension of performance data, and the firm's limited in-house R&D may make improving it harder, so drop probability is higher but still below 50.
